text: {"name":"ble_link_flag_update","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Clears bit 2 of the context flags, then conditionally reasserts it based on a control byte and status/value fields in the selected table entry.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v1":"context_flags","v5":"selected_entry","v6":"entry_status_word","v7":"entry_value"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":136,"meaning":"Start of a list of 16-bit indices into the 12-byte entry table; the first three indices are checked directly."},{"offset":166,"meaning":"Context flags byte; bit 2 is cleared and conditionally set, while bit 5 is also tested."},{"offset":168,"meaning":"Selector used to read an index from the 16-bit entry-index list beginning at offset 136."},{"offset":177,"meaning":"Control byte; values greater than 11 cause bit 2 to be set."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit value in each 12-byte table entry, checked against thresholds."},{"offset":10,"meaning":"Packed status word in each 12-byte table entry."}]}
